title: From Genuine Citations to Warranted Readings: An Edition-Sensitive Audit of AI-Generated Literary Criticism
summary: An authentic bibliographic reference does not, by itself, warrant the scholarly proposition for which it is cited. This distinction is consequential in AI-generated literary criticism, where a fluent interpretation can conceal errors concerning historically different textual witnesses, speakers’ knowledge and the reasoning that connects quotations to claims.
